relationships.subject: ACC population activity
relationships.evidence_quote: we found that the population activity in the ACC reliably and robustly discriminated between stimuli

relationships.subject: neuropathic pain
relationships.evidence_quote: Overall, the supramodal ensemble was more excitable in SNI as compared to sham, showing higher average activation to noxious and non-noxious stimuli

relationships.subject: gabapentin
relationships.evidence_quote: Despite this, GBP restored decoding accuracy and decreased the failure rate of stimulus classification

key_findings: ACC discriminates noxious from other stimuli by population coding; no nociception-specific neurons exist.
Neuropathic pain impairs pattern separation in ACC, partly restored by gabapentin without normalizing supramodal neuron activity.
